a: A token is a chunk of text the model reads or generates.
Context window is how many tokens the model can see at once.
Higher temperature makes sampling more random; lower is more deterministic.
A system prompt steers overall behavior and identity.
Hallucination is confident-sounding false output; verify critical facts.
RAG retrieves documents and feeds them into the prompt for grounded answers.
Embeddings map text to vectors for search and similarity.
Fine-tuning continues training on domain data to adapt a base model.
Inference is running a trained model to produce outputs.
Provider rate limits cap requests or tokens per minute/day.
